extraction.Name: Nellie Anniotte Brown
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 17, 1918 by James Murphy
extraction.Buyer: from Nellie Brown formerly Nellie Anniotte, and Harry Brown conveyed the land to James Kane and James Murphy for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612472 issued; Northwest quarter of section 28, township 100, north of range 76; Deed dated April 15, 1918 to 'N26792'; receipt was signed but not dated; document dated June 1929
